But at least we have two independent dumps to look at and have fun this Saturday erigon seems to have released a fix, i’ll update today. keep an eye on my validators and lmk if you need me to debug anything. im running 2000 validators so should be able to catch low-probability stuff. the node lost (nonoptimistic) sync after: ``` {"lvl":"DBG","ts":"2022-08-27 05:00:43.946+02:00","msg":"newPayload: succeeded","parentHash":"d75fa432","blockHash":"9bd9a300","blockN umber":7479457,"payloadStatus":1} {"lvl":"DBG","ts":"2022-08-27 05:00:44.570+02:00","msg":"newPayload: inserting block into execution engine","parentHash":"9bd9a300","b lockHash":"244c7517","stateRoot":"060da947","receiptsRoot":"56e81f17","prevRandao":"004eb836","blockNumber":7479458,"gasLimit":3000000 0,"gasUsed":0,"timestamp":1661568972,"extraDataLen":0,"baseFeePerGas":"25","numTransactions":0} {"lvl":"DBG","ts":"2022-08-27 05:00:52.468+02:00","msg":"runForkchoiceUpdated: ran forkchoiceUpdated","headBlockRoot":"9bd9a300","fina lizedBlockRoot":"29960b54","payloadStatus":"SYNCING","latestValidHash":"None[BlockHash]","validationError":"None[TaintedString]"} {"lvl":"WRN","ts":"2022-08-27 05:00:52.468+02:00","msg":"expectValidForkchoiceUpdate: forkChoiceUpdated not `VALID`","payloadExecution Status":0,"headBlockRoot":"9bd9a300","finalizedBlockRoot":"29960b54"} ``` and a number of similar ... odd issues. ``` $ grep "expectValidForkchoiceUpdate: forkChoiceUpdated" log.log.log | wc -l 56 ``` can anyone help me count how many bad blocks my validators have produced? also turned out i was running lighthouse 2.5.1, haven't got it updated on that server, although i think this version should've worked with görli fine. I haven't seen any more invalid payloads in the last 24hrs 🎉 If you grep your BN logs for `RejectedByExecutionEngine` you should be able to see how many invalid blocks you've seen *from any producer*. This is how I found them in the first place. I think you should be able to grep your VC logs for the same string and see how many invalid blocks were *produced by you*. all of them 🙂 ``` ~$ journalctl --user -u goerli.validator | grep "published block" | wc -l 191 ~$ journalctl --user -u goerli.consensus | grep RejectedByExecutionEngine | wc -l 21 ``` https://gist.github.com/banteg/d5bc9429673d9288c5c52db95aac59e3 Nice, some of my nodes saw >40 invalid payloads in the past week. I would assume there were other operators with the same bug too. I have a PR open on Lighthouse to make the invalid payload logging a bit easier to deal with: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/3515 maybe would be useful to add a metric for seen invalid payloads too There's `execution_layer_payload_status{status="invalid"}`. That was added in LH v3.0.0 thanks, looks great

excerpts.content: Correct, all the Sigma Prime Prater nodes are running in a purposefully bad configuration in order to trigger forks. It’s part of an effort among consensus clients to test and analyse fork choice.
